children: Russian Central Bank Deputy Governor Alexei Zabotkin said on Monday that there was now less scope for a change in monetary policy and that any future decision would be dictated by the task of returning inflation to its target of 4%.
The central bank will hold its next key rate setting meeting on September 11. At the last meeting, on July 24, the bank cut the rate by 25 basis points to 14%.
